messages:
tariq: :rotating_light: Heads up — large spike in p95/p99 and a flurry of 504s/timeouts in prod immediately after the last rollout. Seeing this from 2001234520. Anyone oncall?
incidents-bot: ALERT: prod error-rate 5xx > 3% (us-west-2) for service "model-serving". Creating incident channel and paging oncall.
camille: p95 jumped from ~120ms -> ~2.8s, p99 up to ~10s on /v1/generate. Edge is returning 504 Gateway Timeout with upstream "inference-runtime". Graphs show spike coincident with deploy at 2001234500.
raj: I'm oncall. pulling logs now. Initial guess: request multiplexing or runtime worker starvation causing long epoll waits. Can someone do a quick curl to replicate?
emily: running a curl against the public API — reproduces. Edge returns 504 after ~60s. curl shows keepalive to backend then connection reset.
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"input":"hi"}' -m 65
# result: HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
```
jordan: checked node metrics on the inference pool. One runtime node showing GC/blocked syscalls and high epoll wait counts. KV cache pressure on that node was elevated after the deploy. Relevant log snippet: 
```text
[2026-03-15T12:02:10Z] inference-runtime[pid=2145]: stall detected waiting on epoll_wait for 60s
[2026-03-15T12:02:11Z] inference-runtime: request handler thread stuck while waiting on socket readiness
```
raj: if runtime threads are stalling, we should stop routing to the new variant. Quick options: failover to previous model variant, toggle routing to dedicated pool, or rollback the deploy. Which is fastest?
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T11:59:30Z -> commit def456 (latest). Available rollback target: abc123. Rollback command: `/rollout rollback def456` or `/rollout restore abc123`.
tariq: rollback seems safest to stop customer impact immediately. @oncall-sre please run rollback and coordinate with infra.
oncall-sre: initiating rollback to abc123 now. rollback start timestamp 2001234575. Will monitor until health checks pass.
support-bot: Creating public incident entry: "Investigating — increased timeouts after deploy". Notifying engineering on-call and ops. Marking preliminary impact: subset of customers in US-West.
camille: alternative would be to throttle traffic to the new pool, but rollback is faster and ensures no more bad deployments. Agree with rollback.
raj: starting canary rollback and will watch error rates. Please hold external comms until we confirm recovery.
deploy-bot: rollback job rb-7890 started. Estimated time to complete ~45s.
emily: metrics watching — p99 trending down: 10s -> 1.2s -> 480ms. Error count also decreasing.
tariq: run smoke tests once rollback completes. Verify sample token traces and ensure no epoll stalls remain.
jordan: smoke test: POST /v1/generate sample -> 200 in <500ms. No epoll_wait stalls in recent logs.
oncall-sre: rollback completed at 2001234630. Health checks green. Error rate back to baseline (<0.1%).
support-bot: status page updated: "Identified and mitigated — rollback to prior release. Some customers may have experienced 504/timeouts; we are notifying affected accounts." Link: https://status.redwood.example/incident/2001234567
tariq: preliminary RCA: a runtime change in the new release altered connection multiplexing behavior; under certain sequence length and KV-cache pressure it could block worker threads leading to epoll waits and request stalls. Need full postmortem and a revert PR for that change.
camille: creating postmortem ticket and assigning owners: raj (SRE lead), jordan (runtime), emily (support triage). tagging eng-runtime, eng-sre, and product for follow-up.
tariq: great coordination. Keep channel open for 1 hour for follow-ups and verification. :thumbsup:
incidents-bot: Incident marked RESOLVED. Duration: 6m3s. Incident ticket INC-2001234567 created and linked.
lisa: filing customer impact notes and billing adjustment checklist for affected enterprise tenants. Will send IO to CS for outreach.
notes: post-incident channel left open for follow-ups
